An empty stone tomb in a hillside at dawn. The large circular stone is rolled to the side. Inside the dark tomb, folded white linen burial cloths rest on a stone slab. A bright angel in shining white garments stands by the entrance, speaking to a small group of women holding jars of spices.

A hilltop on the Mount of Olives. A small group of disciples, in first-century robes, are looking up into the sky with expressions of awe. Above them, Jesus is ascending, partially obscured by a bright, glowing cloud. Two angels in brilliant white robes stand among the disciples, pointing upward.
